dialect.detail: Micro Focus COBOL with OO extensions (class-control, object reference), COMP-X, COMP-5 usage, and Windows GUI (wclass window object). Likely targeting Micro Focus NetExpress or similar Windows-based COBOL environment. Brazilian Portuguese application (KELLO ERP system).

purpose.domain_detail: Accounts receivable (contas a receber) - individual customer statement report listing titles/invoices with payment status (to pay and paid) within a requested movement interval. Part of the KELLO ERP system.
purpose.summary: CRP052 is a batch report program that generates an individual customer accounts-receivable extract (Extrato de Cliente). It lists all financial titles/invoices with status 0 (to pay) or 2 (paid) within a specified date range, printing totals including gross value, net value, balance, average delay days, and interest receivable.

notable_features: OO COBOL class-control with Window object reference (Micro Focus extension)
COMP-X and COMP-5 usage (Micro Focus numeric types)
41 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
Indexed WORK file with multiple alternate record keys
Brazilian Portuguese comments and field names
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS
Complex report layout with multiple header/detail/total lines
